title: Twin 400 kg under-deck tuned mass damper retrofit for 40 m lively footbridge
problem_restatement: Retrofit a 40 m lively footbridge with 1.9 Hz first mode to Medium comfort with hidden under-deck dampers and no deck change.
mechanism_sentence: Bridge shake swings two 400 kg weights hung under the middle of the deck and oil dampers turn that swing into heat so a 8.28 m/s2 shake drops to 0.67 m/s2 with only 49.4 mm of motion.
decisive_choices: Chose twin 400 kg pair detuned about 1.83 Hz (C20) over single exact absorber (C1) because same 800 kg 4% ratio holds 0.476 to 0.526 m/s2 under detuning via MTMD robustness, and over stiffening (C7) needing 46.5% more stiffness to reach 2.3 Hz.

Chose paired dampers with tolerant band inside twin units (C21) over single optimum dashpot (C3) at same 12.0% optimum because exact tune fails on drift, and over add-on parallel fluid unit (C10) which lacks MTMD robustness finding and detuning hold.

Chose HSFG-clamped cross-beam carrying 7.85 kN weight plus 5.22 kN dynamic into girders as shear (C22) over generic welded bracket (C4) because weld-free friction gives 32.9 kN slip per bolt against 13.1 kN demand with fatigue and install advantage.
open_question: Does the after-build instrumented Class III crowd walk-through verify 0.67 m/s2 Medium comfort in place with filed record?
transfer_line: Energy: Under-deck cross-beam -> Tuned mass blocks -> Viscous damper units | Measured: Midspan accelerometer logger -> Comfort verdict record

assumed_constraints.constraint: total added dead load under 2% of pedestrian live load
vertical comfort target maximum comfort below 0.5 m/s2, mean 0.5-1.0 m/s2, minimum 1.0-2.5 m/s2, unacceptable above 2.5 m/s2
maintenance by Below Bridge Access Vehicle or girder-bay walkway with lockable deck hatch per inspection-access rule, plus annual TMD tuning check — deck kept clear during service

concept.working_principle: Bridge motion at the midspan antinode drives two sprung masses where motion is largest, tuned dampers convert relative motion to heat, and a clamped frame carries the push into the girders with nothing on the deck.

parts.name: Under-deck cross beam
parts.function: carries two damper units and moves with midspan antinode

parts.name: Friction clamp bolt set
parts.function: clamps beam to girders without weld

constraint_table.how_shown: Layout sketch shows cross-beam at midspan of the 40 m span and off-antinode calculation shows full effect only there.

constraint_table.design_value: 1.9 Hz bare, 1.83 Hz tune, 1.86 Hz locked
constraint_table.how_shown: Optimum tune sets 1.83 Hz from 1.9 Hz and locked-mass check gives 1.86 Hz so damping must do the work.

constraint_table.constraint: maintain deck appearance with clear walkway
constraint_table.design_value: all steel within girder depth, nothing above deck
constraint_table.how_shown: Layout sketch shows all hardware between girders below soffit above bottom flange with no deck change.

fabrication_steps.description: Fabricate the structural steel cross-beam and clamp plates first, because the masses, springs and stops all bolt to it
fabrication_steps.method: Bolted structural steel beam, 2.5 to 3.0 m span between girders

fabrication_steps.description: Assemble the two 400 kg steel masses on coil springs with parallel viscous dampers, because tune and stroke are set on the bench before lifting
fabrication_steps.method: Assembled steel masses 400 kg each with 105 kN/m coil springs

fabrication_steps.description: Fit caged travel stops with elastomer pads and lockable service pins to the beam, because the 80 mm gap must clear the 49.4 mm stroke plus 74.7 mm sag
fabrication_steps.method: Bolted steel cages with elastomer pads, 80 mm gap, 124 mm envelope

fabrication_steps.description: Clamp the beam between girder webs from below with M20 HSFG bolts and hang the tuned units, because no weld or deck opening is allowed
fabrication_steps.method: HSFG-clamped with M20 bolts, 32.9 kN slip per bolt

risks.mitigation: use twin units detuned about 1.83 Hz holding 0.476 to 0.526 m/s2 and annual re-tune from BBAV

risks.risk: HSFG preload loss and loosening at 1.9 Hz
risks.mitigation: use four bolts with 32.9 kN slip each against 13.1 kN demand plus annual BBAV re-torque
size 80 mm gap beyond 49.4 mm stroke with 124 mm envelope inside girder depth and check 8.40 kN hit into beam
